checked_sources_new.title: Socratic agents for autonomous scientific discovery in high-dimensional physical systems
checked_sources_new.type: primary preprint with real multimode-fibre experimental platform and controlled critic ablation

candidate_mechanisms_new.mechanism: Solution-withholding causal critic / Socratic epistemic interrogation: a dedicated critic is forbidden from supplying the preferred mechanism or conclusion and instead forces the scientific planner to expose definitions, physical constraints, full causal chains, counterexamples, applicability conditions, uncertainty and falsification criteria before an experimental plan is admitted.
candidate_mechanisms_new.evidence: AHOIS evaluates a strategy agent (Boxue) and a Socratic physics critic (Duzhi) on a real multimode-fibre optical platform. Duzhi is explicitly constrained to question rather than propose mechanisms or preferred conclusions. Across seven Socratic rounds, physics-consistency score rises from approximately 2 to above 4.5 on a 0-5 scale, with hypothesis completeness and uncertainty calibration also increasing monotonically. Intervention utility differs sharply by question type: clarification 0.42, physical-constraint checking 0.58, causal probing 0.83, counterexample challenge 0.74. A controlled four-way ablation uses identical scientific prompts for Boxue alone, Boxue+generic reviewer, Boxue+non-Socratic Duzhi and Boxue+full Socratic Duzhi. The full Socratic configuration is reported highest on normalized physics consistency, plan validity, planning efficiency and downstream task performance, with the lowest invalid-plan rate and fewest steps to a valid plan. Generic review improves surface completeness but is weaker on missing causal links/failure conditions; non-Socratic Duzhi often replaces the planner's reasoning with corrective answers.
candidate_mechanisms_new.interpretation: The useful intervention is not generic additional criticism. Withholding solutions while forcing the planner itself to repair causal structure may preserve epistemic ownership and reduce answer-copying from the critic. For scientist-agent design, this suggests a pre-execution critic whose output is restricted to typed questions/counterexamples/rejection conditions rather than candidate answers, coupled to the durable review-closure state machine from candidate 027.
candidate_mechanisms_new.scope: Direct evidence is one supervised high-dimensional optical laboratory system. A human scientist remains present at predefined veto/correction/annotation points. The paper reports normalized four-configuration ablation outcomes graphically/textually but does not expose exact numeric values for all Figure-5d bars in the inspected HTML, so no effect sizes are imputed. The reasoning scores use predefined natural-language rubrics. Large-scale repetitive acquisition in the paper-to-platform demonstration was performed by researchers after pilot validation. The authors do not claim discovery of new physical laws, and open-ended hypothesis generation beyond the known conceptual library remains future work.

evidence_refinements: Candidates 027 and 034 gain a distinct upstream critic design rather than another generic reviewer: candidate 035 can generate typed unresolved findings (clarification, constraint, causal-chain, counterexample/falsification) without injecting a solution; candidate 034 can then route the resulting defect to an aligned repair operator; candidate 027 can keep the finding open until evidence and final claim artifacts are reconciled.

AHOIS supplies a real-physical-platform controlled comparison in which generic review and an answer-giving/non-Socratic critic are both weaker than solution-withholding Socratic interrogation on the reported combined reasoning/planning/downstream metrics. This narrows the mechanism from 'multi-agent debate helps' to 'critic role constraints and question type matter.'
negative_and_boundary_evidence_new: Do not generalize from AHOIS that every critic should withhold solutions. The evidence is a physics-reasoning/planning loop in one optical domain under human supervision, and some procedural/quantitative defects may benefit from direct correction as AutoLabs shows.
Do not infer numeric effect sizes for the four-configuration Figure-5d ablation. The inspected primary HTML reports ordering and qualitative superiority but not all bar values.

Do not equate monotonic rubric-score gains across Socratic rounds with independent proof of scientific truth; the stronger evidence is the controlled configuration comparison plus downstream plan/task metrics, still within the tested platform.
AHOIS is not fully human-free autonomous discovery: human supervision can veto unsafe actions, correct hardware-incompatible plans and annotate uncertain interpretations.
frontier_additions: Inspect AHOIS source/Supplementary material for exact Figure-5d configuration values, sample sizes and uncertainty estimates without reading any other worker state.
Search for an independent or second-domain matched comparison of solution-withholding/question-only critics versus generic or answer-giving critics in scientific agents.

Test a composed control loop: question-only critic -> typed defect -> error-class-specific repair -> durable repair_pending state -> cross-artifact claim reconciliation, under equal model/tool/runtime budget.
Measure whether solution withholding reduces critic-induced convergence/copying while preserving repair rate, and identify defect classes where direct corrective answers are superior.

termination_diagnostics.blocker: Exact numerical values for AHOIS four-configuration Figure-5d ablation were not present in the inspected primary HTML, and no independent second-domain replication was located in this segment.
termination_diagnostics.termination_cause: checkpoint after adding real-platform Socratic critic evidence and preserving scope; frontier remains nonempty

exact_next_action: Inspect AHOIS supplementary/source material for exact critic-ablation values and search a second scientific domain for a matched solution-withholding critic comparison; then continue fixed deterministic review-closure sampling and search critique-only versus mandatory-repair causal interventions, while preserving the clean independence boundary.
